name: Context Mode
description: Runs the upstream context-mode server with npx and adds a skill saying when to use it. No upstream code is shipped: https://github.com/mksglu/context-mode

skills.name: context-mode
skills.description: Keeps large command outputs out of context; may shorten other tools' outputs, so read the PLUT_OS brief by part.

context-mode.purpose: run commands with large output (tests, builds, logs) so only a summary enters context
